verdict.rationale: Zero claims a no-tracking/no-sell data policy and supports self-hosting (giving users full control over their own data and deletion since they own the infrastructure), plus MCP tools include explicit 'delete emails' actions. However, there's no documented data retention policy, no explicit account/data deletion workflow or export tooling described, and no independent verification of the no-tracking claim. missing for 10: documented retention/export/deletion policy for hosted use, independent audit of data practices, explicit account-deletion or right-to-be-forgotten flow.
